quote: You spend years building walls around your fragile heart, convinced that safety lives only in absolute isolation. Yet the quiet room you curated eventually becomes the very cage that suffocates your tired soul. You starved the darkness of its power, but you also locked out the healing light. No one ever told you that protection can feel so heavy. Sometimes the armor hurts worse than the wound ever did.
